# shopify_customer_account_page (Data Source)

Reads a customer account page by handle, for example to reference its GID in a menu item. Customer account pages are created by Shopify and are not managed by this provider. The GID is specific to each shop. Fails if no page has the handle, and lists the handles that exist. Needs the `read_customers` scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Shopify creates the customer account pages; the GIDs differ per shop.
data "shopify_customer_account_page" "orders" {
  handle = "orders"
}

output "orders_page_id" {
  value = data.shopify_customer_account_page.orders.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `handle` (String) Handle of the page, e.g. `orders`. Matched exactly, including case.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Customer account page GID.
- `title` (String) Title of the page.
